item.mng: teyin böged negeküi γurban doγsid-i nomuγadqaγči neretü niγuča dandris
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadiy-a dev-a purny-a mati kiged töbed-ün kelemürči dge slong čhokyi bzangpo orčiγulbai, mongγol-un kelen-dür manǰusri mergen pandita gusi-dur dulduyidču erdeni qončin orčiγulbai,

item.mng: niγučas-un ḓanḓr-a / bügüde-yi teyin büged ilaγaqui γurban doγsid-i nomoγadqaqui neretü
item.coloph: hindkeg-ün / ubadini ḓeu-a bunu mati kiged kelemürči gelong čoyiǰi bsangboi orčiγulbai. , .

item.mng: niγuča tarni ṱandiras-i teyin büged ilγaγsan, γurban doγsin-i nomoγadqaγči kemegdeküi,
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini ṱuva burṇy-a mati kiged, kelemürči sayin nom-tu / orčiγulbai,

item.mng: teyin büged ilγaqui γurban doγsid-i nomoγadqaγči / neretü niγuča ṱandir-a
item.coloph: hindkeg-ün ubadyay-a anu-a yukitla töbed-ün / kelemürči balban čoskyi brčon 'ahgrova orčiγulǰu nayiraγuluγad / orosiγulbai, mongγol-un kelen-dür mañ'ǰusiri mergen / banḓiḓa güisi-dür dulduyidču <erdeni> qonǰin / orčiγulbai. , .
